scenes.heading: Planning in five minutes
scenes.sub: Know your ending before you write the first line
scenes.say: You only have a few minutes to plan in the writing test. Here's how to go from a prompt to a clear plan in about five minutes, so you always know where you're going.

scenes.heading: Think of it like this
scenes.everyday: You check the map before a road trip, not halfway
scenes.science: You plan your piece before writing, ending included
scenes.breaks: a road map is fixed; your plan can change a little as you write, as long as you still reach an ending.
scenes.say: Think of a road trip. You look at the map before you leave, so you know where you're heading. A writing plan is your map. Decide where the piece ends before you start, and every paragraph will head that way.

scenes.heading: The five-minute routine
scenes.say: Here's the routine. First, read and decode the prompt. Second, brainstorm three or four ideas fast. Third, choose one and narrow it. Fourth, write a dot-point skeleton, including your ending.

scenes.heading: Two plan shapes
scenes.say: For a story, plan a hook, a problem, a build and a turn, then an ending. For a persuasive piece, plan a clear position, two or three reasons on the same side, a counter-argument with your reply, and a conclusion.

scenes.heading: One, one, one, one
scenes.say: To narrow a story, use one, one, one, one. One main character, one place, one problem and one short stretch of time. Small stories can be told well in twenty minutes. Big adventures get rushed.

scenes.heading: Fix this plan
scenes.question: Prompt "Change": Mia moves city, starts school, joins a band, loses a friend, wins a prize, moves back. Fix it.
lines: Mia's first morning at the gate
scenes.say: Try this plan for the prompt Change. Mia moves city, starts school, joins a band, loses a friend, wins a prize and moves back. That's six big events, far too many. Narrow it to one moment, like Mia's first morning at the school gate, where she helps someone and takes her first small step.

points: Plan in dot points, about five minutes
Reasons all on the same side
scenes.say: Quick recap. Plan in dot points for about five minutes. Narrow your idea. Keep all your reasons on the same side. And always decide your ending first. Now try the practice questions!
